unitDefinition: Original source registration rows; duplicates retained, not deduplicated vehicles. Forecasts are expected counts, not rounded integers.

geography.unknownRule: Any source UF outside the exact 27-code whitelist is kept in UNKNOWN, never dropped or allocated to a state.

brandRule: Source marca stripped and uppercased equals MITSUBISHI exactly; nonMit is the exhaustive complement, including unclassified brands. Never inferred from model name.

seasonal_naive_bottom_up.label: Sazonal ingênuo bottom-up
seasonal_naive_bottom_up.description: Repeat each disjoint UF × brand-complement count from twelve months earlier, then sum.

seasonal_growth_bottom_up.label: AR sazonal bottom-up
seasonal_growth_bottom_up.description: Fit seasonal log1p-growth AR(1) independently to each bottom series, then sum.

seasonal_growth_base_unreconciled.label: AR sazonal independente (sem reconciliação)
seasonal_growth_base_unreconciled.description: Independent seasonal log1p-growth AR(1) fits at all nodes; diagnostic benchmark only.

mint_shrink_nonnegative.label: MinT-shrink não negativo
mint_shrink_nonnegative.description: Independent all-node base forecasts reconciled by shrinkage-covariance weighted least squares with nonnegative bottom counts.

selection.criterion: Lowest validation allNodes MASE among coherent candidates only; equal node/origin/horizon weights for nonzero seasonal scales.

protocol.evaluation: Expanding rolling origin with complete common 12-step paths. byHorizon pools steps 1..H; atHorizon measures step H only.
protocol.maseDenominator: Each node and origin uses mean |y[t]-y[t-12]| inside its own training window. Zero denominators are excluded from MASE, retained in MAE/bias.
protocol.covariance: Expanding one-step out-of-fold residuals with outcome dates strictly before each forecast origin. Fixed 50% shrinkage toward diagonal plus 1e-6 diagonal ridge; same covariance shape at all horizons.
protocol.covarianceForecastWindow: Each residual at index t is actual[t] minus an independent base forecast trained on [0,t). Residual t is included only when t < origin.
protocol.reconciliation: Solve min b>=0 (S b - base)^T W^-1 (S b - base). Without active bounds this is MinT; active bounds give a nonlinear nonnegative weighted projection.
protocol.modelFamily: Separate regularized seasonal-growth AR(1) on log1p counts for each node, with fixed slope ridge 1.0. Not a SARIMAX or macro model.
protocol.exogenousData: None. Neither future macro observations nor realized future regional shares are used.
protocol.intervals: Not estimated for this hierarchy; no calibrated probabilistic reconciliation or coverage claim.
protocol.testFreshness: The historical test period has been inspected in earlier project work; retrospective and pseudo-out-of-sample, not a new independent or real-time-vintage test.
protocol.originDependence: Overlapping forecast targets induce dependent errors; prediction counts are not independent sample sizes.

limitations: This grouped forecast is a separate candidate family. It does not reconcile or replace the independently selected national SARIMAX/share forecasts.
Shrinkage strength and ridge are fixed design choices, not optimally estimated or tuned on test data. The short residual window makes covariance uncertain.
The one-step covariance shape is reused at horizons 1–12; horizon-specific covariance is not estimated.
Nonnegative constrained projection differs from linear MinT whenever a bound is active; no universal accuracy improvement is assumed.
All counts reconcile to Brazil including unknown UF. Unknown UF is an explicit accounting bucket, not a 28th Brazilian state.
No hierarchical prediction intervals or interval coverage estimates are supplied.
Current source vintage and past test-period inspection limit the result to retrospective experimentation; no operational validation or causal conclusion.
No municipal, vehicle-segment, sales-channel, rental-company or model hierarchy is forecast in this phase.
